view: Frontal chest radiograph, likely AP (scapulae over lung fields, head flexed with mandible/teeth projected over upper mediastinum); L marker at image upper right confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Limited. Hypoinflated film with high hemidiaphragms; the mandible and dentition overlap the upper mediastinum/thoracic inlet because of neck flexion; extensive posterior spinal instrumentation obscures the spine, trachea and much of the central mediastinum; probable rotation/thoracic deformity (asymmetric rib cage). Penetration adequate for lung fields; lung bases partly obscured by abdominal contents and adjacent soft tissue (arms/breast).

devices.type: Posterior spinal fusion instrumentation: two paraspinal rods with multiple hooks/screws and a transverse cross-connector (scoliosis construct), approx 27 cm long
devices.location: Midline, projected over the mediastinum from the cervicothoracic junction (about T1) to the upper lumbar spine, extending below the diaphragm
Image upper right, i.e. patient's left shoulder region, outside the body
Adjacent to the L marker, projected lateral to the patient's left shoulder, external
Both ear lobes, projected at the top of the image on either side of the mandible

devices.type: Curved thick dense external objects, probably wheelchair armrests / positioning frame
devices.location: Bilateral lower corners of the image, lateral to the lower thorax/abdomen, outside the patient

abnormalities.finding: Posterior spinal instrumentation (bilateral rods with hooks/screws and cross-link) from cervicothoracic junction to upper lumbar spine, consistent with prior scoliosis fusion surgery

Asymmetric, deformed thoracic cage with crowded, steeply sloping right ribs and relatively reduced right lung lucency, consistent with residual scoliosis/rotational chest wall deformity (restrictive thorax)
Hypoinflation with elevated hemidiaphragms and small lung volumes
Prominent cardiomediastinal silhouette (CTR appears >0.5), probably exaggerated by AP projection, low lung volumes and thoracic deformity; true cardiomegaly not established
Hazy increased density in the right perihilar / mid zone, most likely overlapping ribs, hilar vessels and rotation rather than true consolidation; low confidence

description_zh: 胸部正面（疑為AP）X光片，吸氣不足、頸部前屈致下頜與牙齒重疊於上縱膈，且脊椎後路固定器遮蔽脊椎及中央縱膈，影像品質受限。可見雙側後路脊椎固定桿（含多枚鉤/螺釘及一橫向連接器）自頸胸交界延伸至上腰椎，符合脊椎側彎矯正術後；胸廓不對稱，右側肋骨擁擠、右肺透亮度相對減低，兩側橫膈上抬，肺容積小。雙肺可見範圍內未見明確實質化、氣胸或明顯肋膜積液，右肺門旁區域略呈模糊增厚，較可能為肋骨與血管重疊所致；心縱膈輪廓顯得寬大，可能與AP攝影及吸氣不足有關。另見雙側耳環、左側L標記與圓形金屬校正球，以及影像下方兩側外部彎曲致密物（疑為輪椅或擺位裝置）。
